candidate.title: DamID
candidate.scope: The middle row labeled DamID (DNA adenine methyltransferase interaction detection) in the assigned Illumina poster: a sequencing-readout schematic with a Dam–protein-of-interest arm and a Dam-only background arm. The image inventory is DNA–protein association; Dam and protein-of-interest components; Create fusion protein; Split sample with upper Fusion protein and lower DAM icons; upper Specific and non-targeted methylation and lower Non-targeted methylation (red marks on blue DNA); two parallel DpnI digestion, Adaptor ligation (magenta termini), DpnII, and PCR routes; and separate black sequence stacks under Align sequences and determine differentially digested sites. HiTS-FLIP above and MPE-seq below are neighboring methods, not targets or alternatives of this card. This is a schematic-level DamID implementation, not a claim that every DamID protocol uses an identical complete NGS library preparation. No organism, protein target, single-cell implementation, inducible system, or historical origin date is assigned.
